code_readback.clip_source_field_not_applicable: data.source is an earlier clip reference, not a shared-still alias; no unsupported field was added.
code_readback.native_supported_route: Official keyframes --shot with ordinary exact-request media cache; no invented scene field, hand-written keyframes manifest or CLI change.
code_readback.cache_identity: Stage.imageKey uses provider/model/composed prompt/negative/reference SHA/seed/dimensions and the image-selection version. Scene IDs and output target do not enter it. The local Stage.imageKey method was invoked only as a pure calculation with declared planned parameters, not a provider or backend call.
code_readback.camera_matters: composeShotPrompt includes camera, so each teaser copies its exact payoff camera.
code_readback.judge_scope: Each scene still needs its own official judge verdict; a cache hit proves neither scene acceptance nor owner approval.

preconditions: Exact current source/visual and fresh narrative reviews, owner script/outline approvals, true production admission and all-in quote remain required. Nothing in this plan starts paid work.

Before an admitted generation, read actual provider/model selection/version, prompt budget and size. Keep each pair in the same immutable project/workdir with identical look/composed prompt/negative/references/seed/dimensions, no correction prompt and no preexisting divergent selected image. The tuple here is a planned 1K example, not a backend settings readback.
Generate each payoff first through official keyframes --shot with --takes 1 and seed offset 0. Continue to its teaser only after that exact first take passes and remains the selected actual image.

production_handoff.on_any_failure_or_changed_request: Stop the pair. Do not reroll either end to a different seed, buy an independently corrected look-alike, use --force or --accept-best to bypass a failed review, or hand-edit a manifest. Change both endpoints together and repeat normal bound source/visual review and admitted generation if a factual/style correction is needed.
actual_verification_required: Read the official keyframes manifest after the two official commands; require equal selected file references and SHA256 for the pair, then hash the actual referenced bytes.
If margins are trimmed, require the same selected derived image file and actual SHA at both ends; equality of original generated-image hashes alone is insufficient.
Require each scene official judge to pass through the ordinary approved route and preserve real cache/job/ledger receipts.
Read actual assembly input references and confirm both setup and payoff consume that same selected image; a local matching prompt or cache key is not completed reuse or media QA.
